substeps.html: At the next door, wait until the guard patrolling the northernmost lane goes south.

substeps.html: If done correctly, you will surge through the western most guards and be able to immediately obtain a goutweed.

substeps.html: Run to the first safe spot, the middle safe spot in the third row of boxes from the entrance, after the trolls patrolling the first row and the eastern second row just pass you.
